evidence.reason: `_timer_schedule_seconds` computes the completion bound from `OnCalendar`, `OnUnitActiveSec`, `OnUnitInactiveSec`, and `AccuracySec` only. It never reads `RandomizedDelaySec`, so a timer template that declares that directive can be accepted while the returned bound omits the additional delay systemd applies; the bound/preflight can therefore be too small. The supplied code confirms the omission in the bound calculation, so this is an implementation correctness defect (fix the bound or reject such timers), not merely a hardening request.
